answer.title: Weekly Timesheet Reminders
answer.trigger: Every Friday at 13:30, check the payroll system for unsubmitted timesheets.
steps: Check the payroll system for employees who have not submitted their timesheets for the current week.
Draft a reminder email for each employee with the missing timesheet dates.
Review the list of drafted reminder emails.
Send the reminder emails to the respective employees.
answer.ai_help: Drafting personalized reminder emails with the correct missing dates for each employee.
answer.human_approval: James reviews and approves the list of reminder emails before they are sent.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, employees might receive an incorrect reminder to submit their timesheet.
